import json, os, random, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time

SUB = "/app/submission/main.py"
PY = sys.executable


def build_config(nrules, rlen, width=4):
    rng = random.Random(7)
    rules = []
    for i in range(nrules):
        ranges = []
        for _ in range(rlen):
            lo = rng.randint(-200, 200)
            ranges.append([lo, lo + rng.randint(0, 5)])
        rules.append({"id": i, "class": i % 100, "priority": rng.randint(-5, 5),
                      "ranges": ranges})
    return {"version": 1, "idle_timeout": 10 ** 9, "packet_limit": 10 ** 9,
            "prefix_width": width, "rules": rules,
            "fallback": {"feature": 0, "threshold": 0, "le": {"class": 1}, "gt": {"class": 2}}}


def run(config, npackets, nflows=1, chunk=1000):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        t0 = time.time()
        p = subprocess.run([PY, "-I", SUB, "compile"], input=json.dumps(config).encode(),
                           stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()
        ctime = time.time() - t0
        path = os.path.join(tmp, "program.json")
        with open(path, "wb") as fh:
            fh.write(p.stdout)
        reqs = []
        t = 0
        for f in range(nflows):
            reqs.append({"op": "open", "flow": f, "time": t})
        rng = random.Random(11)
        for i in range(npackets):
            t += 1
            reqs.append({"op": "chunk", "packets": [
                {"flow": rng.randrange(nflows), "time": t,
                 "source": rng.randint(0, 1), "length": rng.randint(1, 2048)}]})
        for f in range(nflows):
            reqs.append({"op": "close", "flow": f, "time": t + 1})
        data = ("\n".join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs) + "\n").encode()
        t0 = time.time()
        p2 = subprocess.run([PY, "-I", SUB, "stream", path], input=data,
                            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        stime = time.time() - t0
        assert p2.returncode == 0, p2.stderr.decode()[-2000:]
        nmatch = 0
        for line in p2.stdout.decode().splitlines():
            r = json.loads(line)
            for e in r.get("events", []):
                if e["type"] == "match":
                    nmatch += 1
        print(f"rules={nrules} rlen={rlen} packets={npackets} flows={nflows}: "
              f"compile={ctime:.2f}s stream={stime:.2f}s matches={nmatch} "
              f"outbytes={len(p2.stdout)}")


run(build_config(0, 1), 200000, 1)
run(build_config(10, 3), 200000, 1)
run(build_config(100, 8), 200000, 1)
run(build_config(2048, 8), 200000, 1)
run(build_config(512, 32), 200000, 1)
run(build_config(2048, 8), 1000000, 1)
PYEOF
cd /app/tmp/work && timeout 1200 python3 bench.py
